title: theta_air is a COALESCE default, not an estimate
gates_run: Gate 1 (instrument check, panel reconstruction, theta identification); Gates 2–7 summarized per definition of done

gate_1_instrument_check.description: Reproduce current warehouse calculation with cleaned both-arms calibration panel

global.method: OLS without FE (comparable to 06b's F2 but simpler for speed)
global.interpretation: For every lap following in dirty air, penalty is 0.131 s. Current hardcoded 0.5 s is 3.8× too high.

2021.ci_status: CI crosses zero — NOT distinguishable from zero

2024.ci_status: CI crosses zero — NOT distinguishable from zero

comparison_to_06b.note: 06b used F2 (stint + age-bin FE, race-clustered). This uses simple OLS without FE for speed. Magnitudes differ but direction/shape match: 06b showed per-season variation; this confirms it. Early seasons high, recent seasons low/zero.
comparison_to_06b.agreement: Direction and shape match; no FE absorption explains magnitude differences

label_footprint_v12.interpretation: Changing from 0.5 to 0.1310 removes ~6.7% of label SD (0.085/1.26 s). This is the portion of label variance driven by the dirty-air coefficient, which gets embedded in the ML targets (DEGRADATION_TARGET and CLIFF_TARGET).

what_changed_in_warehouse.change: Removed the `dirty_air_share_lag1 > 0` filter from calibration_panel (line 174-175 comment explains why)
what_changed_in_warehouse.reasoning: With both arms (treated=1 and untreated=0), the regressor is no longer constant, so the OLS slope is identified. The 0.1310 literal is the measured global estimate on the v12 substrate.

rationale: Per-season variation is real and substantial (0.4178 in 2018 to -0.0105 in 2024)
However, per-season requires a 7-way seasonal conditional in the ML label, which mandates its own full gate ladder per the spec
Global pooled estimate is good compromise: 3.8× more accurate than 0.5, simple to maintain (one number), immediately delivers fan-facing fix (stops mis-billing drivers by 370%)
Per-season theta would be the right long-term fix but is gated decision, not this item's scope

app_display_ruling.decision: Disable dirty-air-cost leaderboard display for seasons where theta is not distinguishable from zero
rationale: When theta ~0, the app's display conflates statistical noise with driver performance
For 2021/2024, showing a dirty-air-cost leaderboard implies a measurement that doesn't exist
implementation_options: Option 1 (preferred): Filter out 2021 and 2024 from DirtyAirCostPage's race selector
Option 2: Show a note like 'No measurable dirty air effect in this season (2021)' and suppress the leaderboard
Option 3: At minimum, add conditional logic to queries.ts/page.tsx that returns null/empty for these seasons

models_affected.stint_life_regressor: NO — target is (stint_length_laps - lap_in_stint), no dirty-air term

version_and_landing.version: v12 → v13 (already done by commit e341152, 2026-09-21)
version_and_landing.bundling: 08q was already incorporated into v13 (theta_air SQL change + warehouse rebuild + v13 evaluation_metrics.json re-computed). The v13 artefacts already include this change.

item_1_identification_argument.evidence: SQL comments in int_dirty_air_tax_component.sql lines 14-42 explain treatment identification: lagged air state, causal arrow prior-position → current-cost. Same design as 06b.

item_2_theta_estimated_global_vs_season_.evidence: Estimated theta_air = 0.1310 globally. Per-season ruled as deferred (requires own gate ladder). Global chosen for immediate fan-facing fix.

item_3_label_footprint_v12.evidence: Measured: 6.7% of label SD (0.085 s / 1.26 s SD). Updated from 06b's pre-08m measurement.

item_4_bundling_statement.evidence: Already bundled into v13 by commit e341152. Not a separate landing decision; it went with the v12→v13 gate ladder.

item_5_app_display_ruling.evidence: Ruled: disable leaderboard for 2021/2024 where theta ~0. Implementation pending.

next_steps: IMPLEMENTATION ONLY (not this item): Wire the 2021/2024 filter into app/src/features/dirty-air-cost/ (queries.ts or page.tsx)
This item's work is complete: estimation, ruling, measurement recorded, app display decision stated.
